v.3: And how do you know, maybe he would purify himself,
v.4: or take admonition, and the admonition would benefit him!
v.5: But as for someone who is wealthy,
v.7: though you are not liable if he does not purify himself.
v.8: But as for someone who comes hurrying to you,
v.11: No indeed! These [verses of the Quran ] are a reminder
v.17: Perish man! How ungrateful is he!
v.18: From what did He create him?
v.19: He created him from a drop of [seminal] fluid; then proportioned him.
v.20: Then He made the way easy for him;
v.21: then He made him die and buried him;
v.22: and then, when He wished, resurrected him.
v.23: No indeed! He has not yet carried out what He has commanded him.
v.25: We pour down plenteous water [from the sky],
v.26: then We split the earth making fissures in it
v.27: and make the grain grow in it,
v.28: as well as vines and vegetables,
v.32: as a sustenance for you and your livestock.
v.33: So when the deafening Cry comes—
v.34: the day when a man will evade his brother,
v.37: each of them will have a task to keep him preoccupied on that day.
v.38: Some faces will be bright on that day,
v.40: and some faces on that day will be covered with dust,
v.42: It is they who are the faithless, the vicious.
